description_expanded: This unique yet quintessential four-bedroom home at Alys Beach, pairs indoor living with the outdoor perfectly. This vacation rental home is located in a very private area of Alys Beach adjacent to Lake Marilyn. Guests will find a private courtyard with an enclosed loggia featuring a beverage center, grill, outdoor fireplace, soothing pond, and roll-up glass doors to enclose the sitting area for those chilly evenings. Adjacent to the courtyard, guests will find a professionally appointed kitchen, with large dining table and living room with eleven-foot ceilings. As you make your way up the floating staircase, guests will discover three guest bedrooms and a double bunk room with two beautifully-appointed shared bathrooms. Stepping down an exterior walkway, guests will find the very private primary bedroom and ensuite bath that opens to a roof terrace. This level also features a spacious media room that adds an additional sitting area to the home. Parking for this home is located in a two-vehicle garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
